title: Final Exponents
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the exponents lambda_1, lambda_2, and lambda_3 as solutions to the equations of motion.

title: Condition for Boundedness
description: Essential Criteria: The student must state the condition a <= cb or |E| <= c|B| for all components of the four-velocity to be bounded.

title: Lorentz Force Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly express the Lorentz force acting on the particle in terms of E and B.

title: Differential Equations
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the correct differential equations for the components of the four-velocity.

title: Superposition Concept
description: Optional Criteria: The student should mention that the solutions can be expressed as superpositions of exponentials.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes when deriving the equations of motion.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.
